# The Lantern Road — Scripture Way-Pack

Imported from your 84 supplied Day and Night cards. Headlines and card bodies are preserved, including omissions (…), editorial brackets, emphasis, and speaker notes. These are edited card excerpts, not newly transcribed full verses. No verse numbers have been guessed. Add numeric labels such as [1:17] before a verified verse or excerpt to practice each labelled unit; without labels the game uses successive excerpt units. Ordinary editorial brackets remain part of the text.

Cards are distributed through six regions; the original four passage families are Day 8, 18, 23, and 24. The remaining cards can be discovered at camp after finishing the introductory quest. Tags may be freely changed. Unlisted words in the body remain searchable and eligible for encounter matching.

Scripture quotations marked CSB have been taken from the Christian Standard Bible®, Copyright © 2017 by Holman Bible Publishers. Used by permission. Christian Standard Bible® and CSB® are federally registered trademarks of Holman Bible Publishers.

## John 1:29, 10-13 (CSB)

### The Lamb of God… takes away the sin of the world! … Believe in his name.

John saw Jesus… and said, “Here is <u>the Lamb of God</u>, who <u>takes away the sin of the world!</u>” …He was in the world, and the world was created through him, and yet the world did not recognize him. He came to his own, and his own people did not receive him. But to all who did receive him, he gave them the right to be children of God, to those who <u>believe in his name</u>, who were born, not… of the will of the flesh,… but of God.

## John 3:3, 14-17 (CSB)

### God loved the world in this way: He gave his one and only Son… to save [believers].

For God did not send his Son into <u>the world</u> to condemn the world, but <u>to save</u> [it].

## John 15:1-6 (CSB)

### A branch is unable to produce fruit by itself. … Remain in me.

“I am the true vine. …Every branch in me that does not produce fruit [my Father] removes, and he prunes every branch that produces fruit so that it will produce more fruit. …Remain in me, and I in you. Just as <u>a branch is unable to produce fruit by itself</u> unless it remains on the vine, neither can you unless you <u>remain in me.</u> … You are the branches. The one who remains in me and I in him produces much fruit, because you can do nothing without me.”

~ Jesus

### You do not know what tomorrow will bring… if the Lord wills. …Boasting is evil.

## Habakkuk 3:16-19 (LSB)

### Though… the fields yield no food… I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!

I heard, and my inward parts trembled; because I must wait quietly for the… distress… [of invaders]. <u>Though</u> the fig tree should not blossom and there be no produce on the vines, though… the olive should fail and <u>the fields yield no food</u>, though… there be no cattle in the stalls yet I will celebrate in Yahweh; <u>I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!</u> Yahweh, the Lord, is my strength, and He… makes me tread on my high places.
